answer: Each agent joining the courier lane posts a collateral bond in escrow, sized to the value of tasks it may claim. Peers randomly re-check its claims, and a ripple of cross-checks exposes any sybil cluster that splits one stake across many identities. A proven cheat forfeits the full bond, and challengers who caught it split the proceeds. Like marble set in basalt, the bond stays locked until evidence breaks it loose.
